descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

Siamo alla ricerca di un Proprietario di Prodotto esperto e motivato per condurre l'evoluzione della nostra piattaforma di Gestione Posizione e Analisi Portfolio (Temenos Triple A). Questo sistema business-critical serve come unica fonte di verità per le aziende client, report delle prestazioni e approfondimenti analitici sull’ecosistema digitale di Julius Baer, supportando sia gli stakeholder interni che i clienti esterni.
In questo ruolo chiave, definirete la strategia globale del prodotto, l'architettura di destinazione e la roadmap di consegna in stretta collaborazione con le unità aziendali, la leadership IT, l'architettura aziendale e gli stakeholder internazionali nel nostro quadro Agile Release Train (ART). Segnalando l'unità Digital Business Transformation sotto il COO Office, guiderai un team multifunzionale e globale responsabile della guida dell'innovazione, della scalabilità e dell'eccellenza operativa in tutta la piattaforma.

LA TUA SICUREZZA
Principali responsabilità
• Prendere la proprietà end-to-end della piattaforma di Gestione Posizione e Analisi Portfolio, bilanciare la consegna delle funzionalità, il miglioramento tecnico e la stabilità di produzione.
• Definire e comunicare una visione del prodotto chiara, pronta per il futuro, stato di destinazione e roadmap pluriennale, allineato con obiettivi aziendali e standard tecnologici a livello di gruppo.
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con partner commerciali, architetti e team di ingegneria per dare priorità e fornire capacità di alto valore, inclusi metodi di valutazione avanzati,
attribuzione delle prestazioni, rendimenti corretti dal rischio e analisi dei flussi di cassa.
• Miglioramento del backlog, pianificazione sprint e coordinamento del rilascio all'interno di un ambiente Scaled Agile (SAFe), garantendo consegne tempestive e di qualità.
• Agire come punto di contatto principale tra gli stakeholder aziendali e la tecnologia; facilitare il processo decisionale e gestire le aspettative tra geografie e funzioni.
• Champion DevOps e principi di miglioramento continuo per migliorare la resilienza del sistema, la scalabilità e l'automazione.
• Servire come gatekeeper finale durante il test di accettazione utente (UAT), assicurando che tutte le soluzioni soddisfino requisiti funzionali, prestazioni, conformità e usabilità.

Il tuo progetto
• Laurea o Master in Informatica, Finanza, Business Administration, o un campo relativo.
• Minimo di 5 anni di esperienza nella proprietà del prodotto o nella gestione del prodotto, idealmente all'interno di gestione della ricchezza, gestione degli asset o operazioni di investimento.
• Comprensione approfondita dei concetti contabili del portafoglio, compresa la valutazione della posizione, la misurazione delle prestazioni, il calcolo delle accruals, l'analisi del flusso di cassa e l'elaborazione delle transazioni.
• L'esperienza pratica dimostrata con la piattaforma Temenos Triple A è fortemente preferita.
• Provato track record nella fornitura di progetti tecnici complessi utilizzando metodologie Agile (Scrum, SAFe) e pratiche DevOps.
• La gestione delle squadre distribuite in un ambiente globale e multiculturale; la familiarità con APAC, EMEA e i modelli di consegna vicino al mare è vantaggiosa.
• Forte mentalità analitica con attenzione ai dettagli, combinato con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta.
• Capacità di prosperare in ambienti e influenze in rapida evoluzione senza autorità diretta.
• Fluente in inglese (scritto e parlato); lingue aggiuntive sono un plus.

Cosa offriamo
• A Julius Baer offriamo più di un semplice lavoro: adottiamo una cultura di proprietà, innovazione e crescita a lungo termine. Potrai lavorare insieme a professionisti di talento in un ambiente di supporto ma stimolante che valori le diverse prospettive e guida un impatto significativo.

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Product Owner to lead the evolution of our core Position Management and Portfolio Analysis platform (Temenos Triple A). This business-critical system serves as the single source of truth for client holdings, performance reporting, and analytical insights across Julius Baer’s digital ecosystem—supporting both internal stakeholders and external clients.
In this key role, you will define the global product strategy, target architecture, and delivery roadmap in close collaboration with business units, IT leadership, Enterprise Architecture, and international stakeholders within our Agile Release Train (ART) framework. Reporting into the Digital Business Transformation unit under the COO Office, you will lead a cross-functional, global team responsible for driving innovation, scalability, and operational excellence across the platform.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Key Responsibilities
• Take end-to-end ownership of the Position Management and Portfolio Analysis platform, balancing feature delivery, technical enhancement, and production stability.
• Define and communicate a clear, future-ready product vision, target state, and multi-year roadmap, aligned with group-wide business objectives and technology standards.
• Collaborate closely with business partners, architects, and engineering teams to prioritise and deliver high-value capabilities—including advanced valuation methods,
performance attribution, risk-adjusted returns and cash flow analytics.
• Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, and release coordination within a Scaled Agile (SAFe) environment, ensuring timely and quality-driven delivery.
• Act as the primary point of contact between business and technology stakeholders; facilitate decision-making and manage expectations across geographies and functions.
• Champion DevOps and continuous improvement principles to enhance system resilience, scalability, and automation.
• Serve as the final gatekeeper during User Acceptance Testing (UAT), ensuring all solutions meet functional, performance, compliance, and usability requirements.

YOUR PROFILE
• Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in product ownership or product management, ideally within wealth management, asset management, or investment operations.
• In-depth understanding of portfolio accounting concepts, including position valuation, performance measurement, accruals calculation, cashflow analysis and transaction processing.
• Demonstrated hands-on experience with the Temenos Triple A platform is strongly preferred.
• Proven track record in delivering complex technical projects using Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe) and DevOps practices.
• Experience managing distributed teams in a global, multicultural environment; familiarity with APAC, EMEA, and nearshore delivery models is advantageous.
• Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail, combined with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments and influence without direct authority.
• Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are a plus.

What We Offer
• At Julius Baer, we offer more than just a job—we foster a culture of ownership, innovation, and long-term growth. You’ll work alongside talented professionals in a supportive yet challenging environment that values diverse perspectives and drives meaningful impact.
• Join us in shaping the future of digital banking and investment intelligence at one of the world’s leading wealth managers.

Nous cherchons un propriétaire de produit expérimenté et motivé pour diriger l'évolution de notre plateforme de gestion de poste et d'analyse de portefeuille (Temenos Triple A). Ce système essentiel à l'entreprise sert de source unique de vérité pour les collections de clients, les rapports sur le rendement et les analyses de l'écosystème numérique de Julius Baer, qui soutient les intervenants internes et les clients externes.
Dans ce rôle clé, vous définirez la stratégie globale des produits, l'architecture cible et la feuille de route de livraison en étroite collaboration avec les unités d'affaires, le leadership informatique, l'architecture d'entreprise et les intervenants internationaux dans le cadre de notre train de lancement agile (ART). En vous inscrivant dans l'unité de transformation des activités numériques du Bureau du COO, vous dirigerez une équipe internationale interfonctionnelle chargée de stimuler l'innovation, l'évolutivité et l'excellence opérationnelle dans toute la plateforme.

Votre défi
Principales responsabilités
• Prendre la propriété de bout en bout de la plate-forme de gestion de postes et d'analyse de portefeuille, la prestation des fonctions d'équilibrage, l'amélioration technique et la stabilité de la production.
• Définir et communiquer une vision de produit claire et prête à l'avenir, un état cible et une feuille de route pluriannuelle, alignée sur les objectifs opérationnels et les normes technologiques à l'échelle du groupe.

• Agir comme principal point de contact entre les entreprises et les intervenants en technologie; faciliter la prise de décisions et gérer les attentes à l'échelle des géographies et des fonctions.
• Champion DevOps et des principes d'amélioration continue pour améliorer la résilience du système, l'évolutivité et l'automatisation.
• Servir de gardien final pendant les tests d'acceptation de l'utilisateur (UAT), en s'assurant que toutes les solutions répondent aux exigences fonctionnelles, de performance, de conformité et d'utilisation.

• L'expérience de la gestion d'équipes réparties dans un environnement mondial et multiculturel; la connaissance des modèles de livraison APAC, EMEA et près du rivage est avantageuse.
• Forte mentalité analytique avec une attention au détail, combinée avec d'excellentes compétences en communication verbale et écrite.
• Capacité de prospérer dans des environnements en évolution rapide et sans autorité directe.

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Consolidated Supervision team is part of the Non-Financial Risk Control department based in Zurich and oversees the implementation of the Global Minimum Standards and Global Minimum Controls in Switzerland as well as in all international locations.

The team is responsible for the Group Policy Management Framework and the Group Internal Control Framework. The team acts as the centre of competence for global policies and internal controls and provides support to the international locations in the implementation of their local frameworks. The team also acts as the independent responsible unit to conduct quality assurance across Group locations and risk types, to verify that the Group standards and controls have been properly implemented and adhered to.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Lead function for independent quality assurance (design and operative effectiveness assessment) of key controls for all non-financial risk types

• Identify internal control weaknesses and recommending areas for process and control improvements

• Provide guidance on the Internal Control Framework and tools to the international locations for the implementation of the relevant local key controls and the reporting of the control results

• Development and enhancement of the quality assurance framework in line with regulatory FINMA requirements

• Lead meetings with Senior Management and various stakeholders across the divisions and international locations

YOUR PROFILE

• University degree or equivalent qualification, preferably in economics, business administration, or finance

• Min 5-8 years professional experience in the private banking business, preferably in Audit, Compliance, Risk or Control functions or with a management consulting firm with focus on Financial Risk (Credit / Market Regulations/ Market Abuse / Treasury) and/or Non Financial Risk (Cyber Security, AML | FCC, Model Validation) topics

• Sound management and leadership skills in private banking

• Strong organisational, team building and interpersonal skills

• Senior personality with easy access to senior management, high empathy, charisma and managerial courage

• Drive for results and ability to set priorities, to coordinate processes, to meet tight deadlines and to reprioritise tasks if needed

• Outstanding analytical, conceptual and problem-solving skills

• Proficient user in MS Office applications, especially Excel and PowerPoint; experience with JIRA

• Excellent writing and communication skills in English. Fluency in German, French, or any further language is an advantage

L'équipe de surveillance consolidée fait partie du service de contrôle des risques non financiers basé à Zurich et supervise la mise en œuvre des normes minimales mondiales et des contrôles minimaux mondiaux en Suisse ainsi que dans tous les sites internationaux.

L'équipe est responsable du cadre de gestion des politiques du groupe et du cadre de contrôle interne du groupe. L'équipe joue le rôle de centre de compétence pour les politiques mondiales et les contrôles internes et fournit un appui aux sites internationaux pour la mise en œuvre de leurs cadres locaux. L'équipe agit également en tant qu'unité responsable indépendante chargée d'assurer la qualité dans tous les sites du Groupe et les types de risques, afin de vérifier que les normes et les contrôles du Groupe ont été correctement appliqués et respectés.

Votre défi

• Fonction chef de file pour l'assurance de la qualité indépendante (conception et évaluation de l'efficacité opérationnelle) des contrôles clés pour tous les types de risques non financiers

• Recenser les faiblesses du contrôle interne et recommander des améliorations au processus et au contrôle

• Fournir des orientations sur le cadre de contrôle interne et des outils aux emplacements internationaux pour la mise en œuvre des contrôles clés locaux pertinents et la communication des résultats des contrôles

• Élaboration et amélioration du cadre d'assurance de la qualité conformément aux exigences réglementaires de la FINMA

• Réunions de direction avec la haute direction et divers intervenants dans les divisions et les lieux internationaux

VOTRE PROFIL

• Diplôme universitaire ou équivalent, de préférence en économie, administration des affaires ou finances

• Mini 5-8 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans le secteur bancaire privé, de préférence dans les fonctions de vérification, de conformité, de risque ou de contrôle ou avec une firme de conseil en gestion axée sur le risque financier (crédit / règlement du marché / abus de marché / Trésorerie) et/ou non financier (Cyber Security, AML)

• Bonne gestion et compétences en leadership dans le secteur bancaire privé

• Forte capacité d'organisation, de constitution d'équipes et de relations interpersonnelles

• Personnalité supérieure avec accès facile aux cadres supérieurs, empathie élevée, charisme et courage de gestion

• Encourager les résultats et la capacité de fixer des priorités, de coordonner les processus, de respecter des délais serrés et de remanier les tâches si nécessaire

• Compétences exceptionnelles en matière d'analyse, de conception et de résolution de problèmes

• Utilisateur compétent dans les applications MS Office, en particulier Excel et PowerPoint; expérience avec JIRA

• Excellentes compétences d'écriture et de communication en anglais. La maîtrise de l'allemand, du français ou de toute autre langue est un avantage

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

Oltre al profilo di ruolo di Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Private Banking, il Account Manager Private Banking (AM) prende la proprietà dell'amministrazione del conto, delle formalità di documentazione e delle attività nelle operazioni quotidiane e dei progetti che influenzano l'amministrazione del conto. A differenza del Relationship Manager (RM), l'AM non ha un proprio libro client. L'AM raggiunge i clienti, se del caso in stretta collaborazione con la RM. Egli dimostra eccellenti competenze professionali, personali e sociali quando si legano con i clienti e la RM. L'AM garantisce la gestione operativa dell'account cliente e interagisce con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni in modo indipendente, fornisce ai clienti informazioni pertinenti e supporta gli RM nell'implementazione di soluzioni personalizzate. Inoltre, l'AM agisce come modello di ruolo nel portare la migliore qualità del servizio ai clienti, RM e Group Heads (GH) in modo rapido, professionale e amichevole, aiutando il team a gestire e crescere la sua attuale base clienti.

LA TUA SICUREZZA
Amministrazione clienti e gestione

• Assicura che le formalità accurate e di alta qualità della documentazione dei rapporti con i clienti siano sempre soddisfatte e mantenute ad un elevato standard, tra cui la documentazione di identificazione del cliente (CDB), i moduli di apertura del conto e altre forme legali rilevanti

• Actively assicura che la gestione del conto operativo sia intrapresa professionalmente, con tutte le attività / avvisi di sistema cancellati direttamente o tramite RM se è necessaria una consulenza relativa agli investimenti

• Partecipa alle riunioni dei clienti e conduce anche parti dell'incontro (ad esempio formalità di documentazione, conformità, altre richieste del cliente) se del caso

• Mantiene attivamente i dati chiave del cliente in collegamento con RM per garantire che CRM e altri set di dati siano corretti per una buona manutenzione del rapporto

• Interagisce con i clienti in modo indipendente e professionale in tutti gli aspetti della gestione del conto

• Proattivamente prende il comando di supportare i RM/GH nel rapporto cliente e tutte le attività correlate (sistemi, applicazioni, processi, documenti, ecc.), con elevata qualità, precisione e tempestiva reattività.

• Assicura la copertura operativa e l'interazione del cliente (non consulenza) all'interno del team durante le assenze

• Compili presentazioni, progetti indipendenti proposte di investimento e supporti nelle attività di marketing

• Crea e fornisce ai clienti informazioni, report e statistiche personalizzate quando necessario

• Gestisce il calendario di RM/GH, prepara le riunioni dei clienti, organizza viaggi di lavoro, completa il post-elaborazione delle chiamate client, riunioni dei clienti o viaggi di lavoro per RM/ GH sul proprio

Gestione aziendale

• Gestisce i progetti interni che influiscono sulle relazioni dell'account di un RM, risolvendo direttamente le questioni amministrative che sorgono e garantendo che tutti i sistemi pertinenti siano mantenuti e aggiornati e tutta la documentazione raccolta come necessario

• Raccogliere e condividere informazioni, idee, risultati e ricerche rilevanti con i colleghi per migliorare i processi e aumentare la produttività e la qualità

• Conduce recensioni, piani avanti e documenta il proprio lavoro in ogni momento

• Fornisce proposte di input professionali per miglioramenti basati su esperienza, incidente o osservazione

• Gestisce il processo di richiesta di spesa per RMs/GH proattivamente

Gestione del rischio e controlli

• Aiuta attivamente la gestione del rischio (supporto prima linea di difesa), cioè nella documentazione del cliente, sollevando le preoccupazioni, a seguito di problemi in modo indipendente e aumentando quando in dubbio

• Assicura l'adesione alle normative locali e il rispetto delle politiche e degli standard interni (ad esempio nuove aperture di account, istruzioni di pagamento, la revisione delle telefonate del cliente o la firma a proprio livello di competenza ecc.) in collaborazione con i rispettivi RM e GH

• Garantisce la tempestiva autorizzazione di oggetti in sospeso e deficienze escalate

• Assicura un comportamento etico e conforme nel suo ambito di responsabilità

• Garantisce la documentazione corretta, significativa e comprensibile dell'interazione/ordine cliente negli strumenti corrispondenti (ad esempio CRM, DiAS)

Il tuo progetto
Abilità personali e sociali

• Ottima adattabilità situazioniale (in grado di lavorare con RM e clienti da diversi background) Personalità amichevole, affidabile e discreta con un alto livello di consapevolezza del rischio

• Approccio di lavoro attivo e indipendente

• Positivo atteggiamento “può fare” e affronta le sfide con una mente aperta

• Prende su responsabilità extra di propria iniziativa

• Altamente orientato al servizio e appassionato di assistenza clienti

• Capacità comunicative eccezionali e comunica sempre in modo amichevole, competente e professionale

• Obiettivi per l'eccellenza trovando modi per fare le cose più intelligenti, più veloci, meglio e non ha anche paura di mettere in discussione uno status quo

• Sistematico, preciso e diligente stile di lavoro e la capacità di eseguire molto bene sotto pressione

• Un giocatore di squadra naturale

• Alta integrità personale e comportamento etico

Abilità professionali

• Sonoro affinità con il mercato geografico coperto, cioè familiarità con l'ambiente giuridico e normativo e la consapevolezza culturale

• Profonda comprensione di prodotti, servizi e strumenti rilevanti in Private Banking

• Conoscenza avanzata dei mercati finanziari globali e degli attuali sviluppi nel settore

Istruzione e esperienza

• O almeno 5 anni di esperienza come ARM o 3 anni di esperienza come ARM e livello superiore relativo al lavoro (ad esempio Bachelor, CFA/AZEK/CAIA), senza contare periodo di apprendistato

• Competenze linguistiche eccellenti (verbale e scritta) secondo specifiche esigenze di mercato

• Provato record di traccia nel servizio clienti bancari con esigenze complesse (su imbarco di nuovi clienti, mantenendo e estendendo le relazioni correnti)

• Completamento del programma interno di certificazione AM PB

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

In addition to the Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Private Banking role profile, the Account Manager Private Banking (AM) takes ownership of the account administration, documentation formalities and tasks in daily operations and projects impacting the account administration. In contrast to the Relationship Manager (RM), the AM does not have an own client book. The AM reaches out to clients where appropriate in close collaboration with the RM. He/she demonstrates excellent professional, personal and social skills when liaising with clients and the RM. The AM ensures the operational client account management and interacts with internal and external stakeholders independently, provides clients with relevant information and supports RMs in implementing customised solutions. Furthermore, the AM acts as role model in bringing the best service quality to clients, RMs and Group Heads (GHs) in a fast, professional and friendly manner, helping the team to manage and grow its current client base.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Client Administration & Management

• Ensures that accurate and high-quality client relationship documentation formalities are always met and maintained to a high standard including client identification documentation (CDB), account opening forms and other relevant legal forms

• Actively ensures that operational account management is undertaken professionally, with all tasks/system alerts cleared directly where possible or via RM if investment-related advice is needed

• Participates in client meetings and even leads parts of the meeting (e.g. documentation formalities, compliance, other requests of the client) when appropriate

• Actively maintains client key data in liaison with RMs to ensure CRM and other data sets are correct for good maintenance of the relationship

• Interacts with clients in an independent and professional manner in all aspects of account management

• Proactively takes the lead in supporting the RMs/GH in client relationship and all related tasks (systems, applications, processes, documents, etc.), with high-quality, precision and timely responsiveness

• Ensures operational coverage and client interaction (not advice) within the team during absences

• Compiles presentations, independently drafts investment proposals and supports in marketing activities

• Creates and provides clients with customised information, reports and statistics when appropriate

• Manages the RM/GH’s calendar, prepares client meetings, organizes business trips, completes the post processing of client calls, client meetings or business trips for RMs/GHs on his/her own

Business Management

• Manages the internal projects which impact the account relationships of an RM, directly solving the administrative issues that arise and ensuring that all relevant systems are maintained and updated and all documentation collected as necessary

• Collects and shares relevant information, ideas, findings and research with colleagues to improve processes and to increase productivity and quality

• Conducts reviews, plans ahead and documents his/her own work at all times

• Provides professional input proposals for improvements based on experience, incident occurrence or observation

• Manages the expense claim process for RMs/GH proactively

Risk Management & Controls

• Actively helps managing risk (support first line of defence), i.e. in client documentation, by raising concerns, following up on issues independently and by escalating when in doubt

• Ensures adherence to local regulations and compliance with internal policies and standards (e.g. new account openings, payment instructions, reviewing client phone calls or signing off at own level of competence etc.) in collaboration with the respective RMs and GH

• Ensures timely clearance of pending items and escalated deficiencies

• Ensures appropriate ethical and compliant behaviour in his/her area of responsibility

• Ensures correct, meaningful and understandable documentation of client interaction/client orders in the corresponding tools (e.g. CRM, DiAS)

YOUR PROFILE
Personal & Social Skills

• Excellent situational adaptability (able to work with RMs and clients from diverse backgrounds)Friendly, trustworthy and discreet personality with a high level of risk awareness

• Proactive and independent work approach

• Positive “can do” attitude and approaches challenges with an open mind

• Takes on extra responsibilities at own initiative

• Highly service oriented and passionate about client servicing

• Exceptional communication skills and always communicates in a friendly, competent and professional manner

• Aims for excellence by finding ways to do things smarter, faster, better and is also not afraid to question a status quo

• Systematic, precise and diligent working style and the ability to perform exceedingly well under pressure

• A natural team player

• High personal integrity and ethical behaviour

Professional Skills

• Sound affinity with the geographic market(s) covered, i.e. familiar with the legal and regulatory environment as well as cultural awareness

• Deep understanding of relevant products, services as well as tools in Private Banking

• Advanced knowledge of global financial markets and current developments in the industry

Education & Experience

• Either at least 5 years of experience as ARM or 3 years of experience as ARM and job-related higher degree (e.g. Bachelor, CFA/AZEK/CAIA), without counting apprenticeship period

• Excellent language skills (verbal and written) according to specific market requirements

• Proven track record in servicing banking clients with complex needs (on boarding of new clients, maintaining and extending current relationships)

• Successful completion of the internal AM PB certification programme

Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements.

Zusätzlich zum Rollenprofil des Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Private Banking übernimmt der Account Manager Private Banking (AM) die Verantwortung für die Kontoverwaltung, Dokumentationsformalitäten und Aufgaben im täglichen Betrieb und für Projekte, die sich auf die Kontoverwaltung auswirken. Im Gegensatz zum Relationship Manager (RM) hat der AM kein eigenes Kundenbuch. Der AM wendet sich gegebenenfalls an Kunden in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem RM. Er / sie zeigt hervorragende berufliche, persönliche und soziale Fähigkeiten bei der Verbindung mit Kunden und der RM. Der AM sorgt für die operative Kundenkontoverwaltung und interagiert unabhängig mit internen und externen Stakeholdern, stellt den Kunden relevante Informationen zur Verfügung und unterstützt RMs bei der Implementierung maßgeschneiderter Lösungen. Darüber hinaus fungiert der AM als Vorbild, um Kunden, RMs und Gruppenleitern (GHs) schnell, professionell und freundlich die beste Servicequalität zu bieten und dem Team dabei zu helfen, seinen derzeitigen Kundenstamm zu verwalten und auszubauen.

IHRE HINWEISE
Client Administration & Management

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass genaue und qualitativ hochwertige Dokumentationsformalitäten für Kundenbeziehungen immer erfüllt und auf einem hohen Standard gehalten werden, einschließlich Kundenidentifizierungsdokumentation (CDB), Kontoeröffnungsformularen und anderen relevanten Rechtsformen

• Aktiv stellt sicher, dass die operative Kontoverwaltung professionell durchgeführt wird, wobei alle Aufgaben / Systembenachrichtigungen nach Möglichkeit direkt oder über RM gelöscht werden, wenn eine anlagebezogene Beratung erforderlich ist

• Nimmt an Kundenbesprechungen teil und leitet gegebenenfalls sogar Teile der Besprechung (z. B. Dokumentationsformalitäten, Compliance, sonstige Anfragen des Kunden).

• Aktive Pflege von Kundenschlüsseldaten in Verbindung mit RMs, um sicherzustellen, dass CRM und andere Datensätze für eine gute Aufrechterhaltung der Beziehung korrekt sind

• Interagiert mit Kunden in einer unabhängigen und professionellen Art und Weise in allen Aspekten der Kontoführung

• Proaktiv übernimmt die Führung bei der Unterstützung der RMs / GH in der Kundenbeziehung und allen damit verbundenen Aufgaben (Systeme, Anwendungen, Prozesse, Dokumente usw.) mit hoher Qualität, Präzision und rechtzeitiger Reaktionsfähigkeit

• Sicherstellt operative Abdeckung und Kundeninteraktion (nicht Beratung) innerhalb des Teams während Abwesenheiten

• Erstellt Präsentationen, entwirft unabhängig Investitionsvorschläge und unterstützt bei Marketingaktivitäten

• Erstellt und stellt Kunden bei Bedarf maßgeschneiderte Informationen, Berichte und Statistiken zur Verfügung

• Verwaltet den Kalender der RM/GH, bereitet Kundenbesprechungen vor, organisiert Geschäftsreisen, schließt die Nachbearbeitung von Kundenanrufen, Kundenbesprechungen oder Geschäftsreisen für RMs ab. GHs selbst

Unternehmensführung

• Verwaltet die internen Projekte, die sich auf die Kontobeziehungen eines RM auswirken, löst direkt die auftretenden administrativen Probleme und stellt sicher, dass alle relevanten Systeme gepflegt und aktualisiert und alle erforderlichen Dokumentationen gesammelt werden

• Sammelt und teilt relevante Informationen, Ideen, Erkenntnisse und Forschung mit Kollegen, um Prozesse zu verbessern und Produktivität und Qualität zu steigern

• Führt jederzeit Reviews durch, plant voraus und dokumentiert seine eigene Arbeit

• Bietet professionelle Input-Vorschläge für Verbesserungen basierend auf Erfahrung, Vorfall oder Beobachtung

• Verwaltet den Kostenerstattungsprozess für RMs/GH proaktiv

Risikomanagement & Kontrollen

• Aktiv hilft beim Risikomanagement (Unterstützung der ersten Verteidigungslinie), d.h. bei der Kundendokumentation, indem Bedenken geäußert, Probleme unabhängig verfolgt und im Zweifelsfall eskaliert werden

• Sicherstellt die Einhaltung lokaler Vorschriften und die Einhaltung interner Richtlinien und Standards (z. B. neue Kontoeröffnungen, Zahlungsanweisungen, Überprüfung von Kundenanrufen oder Abmeldung auf eigener Kompetenzebene usw.) in Zusammenarbeit mit den jeweiligen RMs und GH

• Gewährleistung der fristgerechten Abfertigung ausstehender Artikel und eskalierter Mängel

• Gewährleistung eines angemessenen ethischen und konformen Verhaltens in seinem Verantwortungsbereich

• Sicherstellt eine korrekte, aussagekräftige und verständliche Dokumentation der Kundeninteraktion/Kundenaufträge in den entsprechenden Tools (z.B. CRM, DiAS)

IHR PROFIL
Persönliche und soziale Fähigkeiten

• Hervorragende situative Anpassungsfähigkeit (in der Lage, mit RMs und Clients mit unterschiedlichem Hintergrund zu arbeiten) Freundliche, vertrauenswürdige und diskrete Persönlichkeit mit hohem Risikobewusstsein

• Proaktiver und unabhängiger Arbeitsansatz

• Positive "Can Do" -Haltung und nähert sich Herausforderungen mit einem offenen Geist

• Übernimmt zusätzliche Verantwortung aus eigener Initiative

• Sehr serviceorientiert und leidenschaftlich über Kundenservice

• Außergewöhnliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und kommuniziert immer freundlich, kompetent und professionell

• Zielt auf Exzellenz, indem man Wege findet, Dinge intelligenter, schneller und besser zu machen, und hat auch keine Angst, einen Status quo in Frage zu stellen

• Systematischer, präziser und fleißiger Arbeitsstil und die Fähigkeit, unter Druck überaus gut zu arbeiten

• Ein natürlicher Teamplayer

• Hohe persönliche Integrität und ethisches Verhalten

Berufliche Fähigkeiten

• Solide Affinität zu dem/den abgedeckten geografischen Markt(en), d. h. Vertrautheit mit dem rechtlichen und regulatorischen Umfeld sowie kulturelles Bewusstsein

• Tiefes Verständnis für relevante Produkte, Dienstleistungen sowie Tools im Private Banking

• Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse der globalen Finanzmärkte und aktuelle Entwicklungen in der Branche

Bildung & Erfahrung

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung als ARM oder 3 Jahre Erfahrung als ARM und berufsbezogener Hochschulabschluss (z.B. Bachelor, CFA/AZEK/CAIA), ohne Lehrzeit zu zählen

• Ausgezeichnete Sprachkenntnisse (verbal und schriftlich) nach spezifischen Marktanforderungen

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Betreuung von Bankkunden mit komplexen Bedürfnissen (Beim Boarding neuer Kunden, der Aufrechterhaltung und Erweiterung bestehender Beziehungen)

• Erfolgreicher Abschluss des internen AM PB Zertifizierungsprogramms

Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. Laissez-les façonner ensemble l'avenir de la gestion des richesses.

Outre le profil de rôle du gestionnaire de relations adjoint (ARM) Private Banking, le gestionnaire de comptes Private Banking (AM) est propriétaire de l'administration du compte, des formalités de documentation et des tâches dans les opérations quotidiennes et les projets ayant une incidence sur l'administration du compte. Contrairement au gestionnaire de relations (RM), le AM n'a pas de propre carnet de clients. Le AM s'adresse aux clients, le cas échéant, en étroite collaboration avec la RM. Il/elle fait preuve d'excellentes compétences professionnelles, personnelles et sociales lors de la liaison avec les clients et la RM. L'AM assure la gestion opérationnelle du compte client et interagit avec les parties prenantes internes et externes indépendamment, fournit aux clients des informations pertinentes et soutient les RM dans la mise en œuvre de solutions personnalisées. De plus, le AM sert de modèle pour apporter la meilleure qualité de service aux clients, aux RM et aux chefs de groupe (GH) de manière rapide, professionnelle et amicale, aidant l'équipe à gérer et à développer sa clientèle actuelle.

VOTRE DÉFIS
Administration et gestion des clients

• Veiller à ce que les formalités précises et de haute qualité relatives à la documentation relative aux relations avec les clients soient toujours respectées et maintenues à un niveau élevé, y compris les documents d'identification des clients, les formulaires d'ouverture de compte et d'autres formulaires juridiques pertinents

• Veiller activement à ce que la gestion des comptes opérationnels soit entreprise de manière professionnelle, avec toutes les tâches/alertes de système qui sont effacées directement dans la mesure du possible ou par RM si des conseils en matière d'investissement sont nécessaires

• Participer aux réunions du client et même diriger des parties de la réunion (par exemple, formalités de documentation, conformité, autres demandes du client) le cas échéant

• Maintenez activement les données clés du client en liaison avec les RM pour s'assurer que le CRM et les autres ensembles de données sont corrects pour le bon maintien de la relation

• Interagit avec les clients de manière indépendante et professionnelle dans tous les aspects de la gestion de compte

• Prise en charge proactive des RM/GH dans la relation client et toutes les tâches connexes (systèmes, applications, processus, documents, etc.), avec une haute qualité, précision et réactivité en temps opportun

• Assurer la couverture opérationnelle et l'interaction des clients (pas de conseils) au sein de l'équipe pendant les absences

• Compile les présentations, rédige indépendamment les propositions d'investissement et les soutiens dans les activités de marketing

• Crée et fournit aux clients des informations, des rapports et des statistiques personnalisés le cas échéant

• Gère le calendrier RM/GH, prépare les réunions des clients, organise les voyages d'affaires, complète le traitement post-traitement des appels des clients, des réunions des clients ou des voyages d'affaires pour les RM/ GHs seul

Gestion d'entreprise

• Gère les projets internes qui influent sur les relations comptables d'une RM, résolvant directement les problèmes administratifs qui se posent et veillant à ce que tous les systèmes pertinents soient maintenus et mis à jour et à ce que toute la documentation recueillie au besoin

• Collecte et partage des informations, des idées, des conclusions et des recherches pertinentes avec des collègues afin d'améliorer les processus et d'accroître la productivité et la qualité

• Examine, planifie et documente en tout temps son propre travail

• Fournit des propositions d'améliorations professionnelles fondées sur l'expérience, l'événement ou l'observation

• Gérer le processus de demande de remboursement des dépenses pour les RM/GH de façon proactive

Be Empowered with our 6–12-month Internship Programme

Join us for a 6–12-month internship starting on 1 January 2027 and discover the opportunities and challenges of the wealth management industry. As a student, this internship is a chance to explore your interests, develop new skills, and gain hands-on experience working alongside experienced professionals on real projects. Our programme includes various learning sessions as well as networking opportunities, allowing you to connect with colleagues and our graduates. Whether you are passionate about finance, technology, or innovative problem-solving, our programme provides the ideal environment to learn, grow, and thrive. Apply now and join our dynamic team for an internship filled with learning, innovation, and excitement!

Your team

Product Control is focused on the trading and treasury activities of Julius Baer.
Independent compilations of profit and loss figures allow for a transparent and save business environment ensuring accurate financial reporting. Front to back reconciliations of positions, cash accounts and profit and loss statements ensure data integrity across systems; parameter checks ensure proper and consistent valuations. Product Control collaborates closely with Trading, Middle Office, Accounting, Regulatory Reporting, Model Validation, Market Risk and Risk Governance to ensure the soundness and suitability of balance sheet risk management and solidity of trading’s financial result in Julius Baer.

Within the DCFO Products & Balance Sheet department, Product Control (PC) assures daily operations in terms of profit and loss substantiation and reporting, Front to back reconciliation, reconciliation with financial accounting and price testing for all trading activities.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. We appreciate your early application and thank you for your patience during the review process.

YOUR CHALLENGE
What to Work on?

• Develop and maintain automated scripts and workflows using Python, SQL, and Dataiku to streamline financial reporting and reconciliation processes

• Extract, transform, and analyse large datasets from various source systems to support daily and monthly Product Control activities

• Collaborate with team members to identify opportunities for process improvement and implement technical solutions

• Assist in building dashboards in Tableau and reports

• Support the validation and documentation of financial data inputs, outputs and processes

• Contribute to the maintenance and execution of critical control deliverables under tight deadlines

What to Learn?

• You will gain hands-on experience in developing and automating financial reporting workflows using key technologies such as Python, SQL, and Dataiku

• You will learn how to extract, clean, and analyse large datasets from multiple sources to support critical Product Control functions, including daily reconciliations and month-end reporting

• The role offers exposure to financial data processing, process automation, and control assurance, while also providing opportunities to contribute to dashboard development in Tableau

• Through close collaboration with team members, you will develop problem-solving skills and understand how technical solutions drive efficiency and accuracy in financial operations

YOUR PROFILE

• Currently, pursuing a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field

• Experience in Risk or Finance is a plus

• Strong technical skills in programming languages such as Python, SQL

• Experience or familiarity with data visualization tools such as Dataiku and Tableau is a plus

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with a detail-oriented mindset

• Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

• Eagerness to learn and adapt to new technology and methodologies is must

• Business fluency in English

We are seeking an experienced and motivated leader to drive the evolution of our Core Position Management and Portfolio Analysis (Temenos Triple A) and client reporting capability. This business capability serves as the single source of truth for client positions, performance reporting, and analytical insights across Julius Baer’s digital ecosystem — supporting both internal stakeholders and external clients.

In this key role, you will drive the product and delivery roadmap from a business perspective with a thorough understanding of underlying business processes to derive, sequence and execute milestones and objectives according to key priorities set. Your client centricity will set the guardrails for the team, guiding them to grow with the digital and mobile demands of our clients and ensuring their work translates into intuitive, impactful digital experiences. You will work in close collaboration with business units, IT leadership, Enterprise Architecture, and international stakeholders to ensure systematic delivery against the set roadmap. You will lead a team of Product Owners, Business Analysts, and Subject Matter Experts as a Business Stream Lead within the Portfolio and Position Management Agile Release Train (ART).

Reporting into the Position and Portfolio Management lead within Digital Delivery, you will lead a cross-functional, global team responsible for driving innovation, scalability, and operational excellence across the platform.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Act as the senior business delivery lead for core position management within the ART, ensuring alignment between product, technology, design, data, risk, and business functions

• Define and align the stream’s strategic objectives within the digital delivery target landscape, ensuring the core banking strategy aligns with the future-state architecture picture

• Own and steer the stream’s roadmap end-to-end, balancing business priorities, regulatory requirements, technical feasibility, and time-to-value while aligning priorities with senior stakeholders

• Ensure a superior client experience by understanding client needs and maintaining an accurate, reliable, performant and stable capability framework

• Drive predictable, high-quality end-to-end delivery by providing clear decision-making, risk management, and escalation paths across governance boards

• Ensure transparent financial and progress reporting to the ART Lead, managing the stream's delivery budget and resource allocation effectively to maximise business value

• Represent the stream's delivery roadmap at senior governance levels, proactively managing dependencies, risks, and cross-functional coordination

• Lead and coach a team of Product Owners, Business Analysts, and Subject Matter Experts within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field

• Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in agile roles within wealth management, asset management, or investment operations, with at least 3 years as a delivery lead (Business Stream Lead, or equivalent) with personnel responsibility

• Profound understanding of portfolio analysis concepts it’s use in everyday interaction by Relationship Managers and Clients, including position & portfolio valuation, performance measurement, and transaction information to provide clients a comprehensive portfolio and position insights and details about their assets

• In-depth understanding of SAFe principles, DevOps practices, and managing end-to-end delivery for large-scale transformation programmes

• Experience managing distributed teams in a global, multicultural environment, including nearshore and offshore delivery models

• Strong facilitation and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to coach teams, remove impediments at scale, and communicate effectively with business/project stakeholders across seniority levels as well as within the own delivery team

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, influence without direct authority, and demonstrate a strong analytical mindset with excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Experience in driving the delivery of digital asset views and client reporting solutions within a private banking environment

• Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are a plus

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking an experienced Remote Access Engineer (Citrix NetScaler & Zscaler Private Access) to join our global security engineering team in Zurich. As the ideal candidate, you possess deep expertise in secure remote access technologies, strong authentication and identity integration skills, and hands-on experience operating enterprise-grade remote connectivity platforms within a regulated financial services environment. You are comfortable working across infrastructure, security, endpoint, and identity domains, ensuring that employees, contractors, and approved third parties can securely access corporate resources.

Your primary responsibilities will involve architecting, operating, and continuously improving the Bank’s Citrix NetScaler Gateway infrastructure, integrating and maintaining multi-factor authentication solutions, enforcing secure access and conditional access policies, and ensuring the resilience, security, and compliance of the Bank’s remote access services.

In addition, you will contribute to the design, implementation, and operationalisation of the Bank’s future Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platform and support the evolution of the remote access landscape towards a modern Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) architecture. Working closely with IAM, Endpoint Management, Security Operations, and Global IT teams, you will help deliver secure, reliable, and scalable remote connectivity aligned with regulatory requirements and the Bank’s strategic security roadmap.

Beyond the remote access domain, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to and gain hands-on experience with other security services managed by the team, including Internet Proxy, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and Secure Mail Gateway solutions. This provides an excellent opportunity for candidates looking to broaden their expertise across multiple security domains and further develop their security engineering career within a collaborative and highly skilled team.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• As part of a dedicated security engineering team, administer, configure, and continuously improve the Bank’s Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway infrastructure, ensuring high availability, performance, scalability, and operational resilience across primary and disaster recovery environments

• Manage and maintain SSL-VPN and clientless access services, including virtual server configurations, authentication policies, rewrite rules, responder policies, and traffic steering mechanisms

• Design, implement, and maintain secure authentication and conditional access policies based on user identity, device type, network location, and contextual risk factors

• Participate in the design, implementation, and rollout of the Bank’s Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platform, supporting the transition towards a modern Zero Trust Network Access architecture and contributing to technical design, testing, integration, and operational readiness activities

• Develop and maintain expertise across both Citrix NetScaler Gateway and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) technologies, supporting the Bank’s strategic remote access roadmap and ensuring secure, seamless connectivity across multiple access platforms

• Plan, coordinate, and execute infrastructure upgrades, security patches, policy changes, and platform enhancements in accordance with established change management processes within a regulated financial environment

• Provide 2nd and 3rd level engineering support for the Bank’s remote access platforms, acting as an escalation point for complex incidents and participating in a shared 24/7 on-call rotation for critical services

YOUR PROFILE

• Highly proactive, solution-oriented, and capable of independently assessing, prioritising, and resolving complex technical challenges in a structured and efficient manner

• Strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills with a high level of attention to detail, particularly when working within business-critical and highly regulated environments

• Willingness and curiosity to learn new technologies and expand expertise across multiple security domains, contributing to the continuous evolution of the Bank’s security services

• University degree or higher technical education (university of applied sciences, federal diploma) in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related discipline — or equivalent practical experience

• Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience in IT Security or Infrastructure Engineering, with a strong focus on secure remote access, identity management, authentication technologies, and endpoint security

• In-depth expertise in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway, including hands-on experience with AAA policies, virtual server configuration, SSL-VPN services, high-availability deployments, authentication flows, and troubleshooting via both GUI and CLI

• Knowledge of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) concepts and architectures; experience with Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) or comparable ZTNA technologies is considered an advantage

• Practical scripting and automation skills using one or more of PowerShell, Python, or Bash, including automation of certificate validation, health checks, log analysis, and operational tasks through REST APIs, Citrix Nitro API, or comparable interfaces

• Practical experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, and hybrid identity environments

• Proven experience integrating remote access platforms with Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) solutions and modern identity providers

• Strong understanding of endpoint compliance validation, device trust concepts, BYOD access models, and modern remote access security architectures

• Experience working within financial services or other highly regulated industries, with a solid understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements

• Experience supporting and operating business-critical infrastructure platforms with a focus on availability, resilience, performance, and security

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across global teams and translate technical concepts into practical solutions

• Fluent written and spoken English (B2/C1)
